slop-detector.description: Detect AI-generated code quality issues (duplicates, dead code, placeholders)

executive-reporting.description: Generate executive status reports, dashboards, and board packages from SpecFlow feature artifacts

project-health-check.description: 6-dimension project health assessment with weighted scoring and flag analysis

toolInstall.soffice: brew install libreoffice (macOS) or apt install libreoffice (Linux)
toolInstall.pdftoppm: brew install poppler (macOS) or apt install poppler-utils (Linux)

pptx.description: Generate PowerPoint presentations from scratch or edit templates

skill_fields: bundled: boolean - If true, skill ships with SpecFlow (init copies it)
install: string - External source for downloadable skills (name@owner/repo)
tools: string[] - CLI tools required by this skill
toolInstall: object - Install commands for each tool {tool: 'command'}
review-capable: boolean - If true, skill can be used by sf-review
report-capable: boolean - If true, skill can generate executive reports (used by PM for report triggers)
scope-minimum: string - Minimum scope level to trigger (trivial|small|medium|large|complex)
